datasheet_identity.title: SS12F THRU SS120F Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 matches the expected digest 65d8f6d8760894c5c115f7d9626f16c7dc2b13fbd2d85d30b082fcc616de23e9.
SS14F is a Schottky barrier rectifier. The datasheet marks the cathode with a band; forward current is interpreted from anode to cathode.

Forward curve points were digitized from the vector SS12F-SS14F trace in Fig. 3. Reverse curve points were digitized from the SS12F-SS16F traces in Fig. 4 at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC. No intermediate points were interpolated from the electrical table.

The electrical-characteristics table uses merged cells: SS14F shares the 0.55 V maximum forward-voltage entry with SS12F, the 0.5 mA maximum reverse-current entry with the 20 V to 100 V devices, and the 110 pF typical junction-capacitance entry with SS12F through SS16F.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification and no reverse-breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification.
